newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania president to Poland on first official trip.
newsitem.headline: Romania president to Poland on first official trip.

text.p: Romanian President Emil Constantinescu will visit Poland on January 13 and 14, his first official visit since his election last November, the foreign ministry said on Wednesday.

The two ex-communist countries have pledged support for each other in their efforts to join NATO with Warsaw better placed for quick integration as the Western defence alliance goes on with its eastward expansion plans later this year.

Constantinescu is returning Aleksander Kwasniewski's visit to Romania last year, the first by a Polish president since 1939 when the Warsaw government was evacuated across the then common border with Romania to flee Nazi invasion.
Modern-day Ukraine now divides Romania from Poland, after the Soviet Union took control of large swathes of former Polish and Romanian land under secret protocols of the 1939 pact with Nazi Germany.
